charter: make per-tensor-scale FP8-ST decode NATIVELY on e4m3 instead of paying the ARM B' Q8_0-slab tax
note: ONE frozen run-gen for every arm; an earlier A/B attempt was discarded because a mid-run rebuild would have split arms across binaries

finding: the local 27B is a per-tensor-scale FP8 artifact for its whole attention+linear-attn stack -> this lane's arm applies to it TODAY, and its 24GB e2e fit refutes the fp8v3-gate assumption that 27B FP8 e2e needs the 96GB pod
scope_note: block-128 checkpoints still fall back cleanly to the slab path (model.rs requires f8.blk.is_none())

verdict: measured == theory to 5 decimal places -> single residency, NO dual copy. Contrast MEMRA_PP_FP8, whose stash keeps e4m3 ON TOP of the Q8_0 slab (that is the arm that needed a budget and OOM'd at 8.7% coverage). Native residency REPLACES the slab, it does not duplicate it.

protocol: INTERLEAVED A,B pairs in ONE flock hold, N=5, one binary; thermal 59->74C, clocks 1687-1807MHz after r1 ramp
separation: min(B)=39.71 > max(A)=38.76 -- the distributions do not overlap

arm_C: MEMRA_ST_E4M3=1 MEMRA_E4M3_DUAL=0 (native bytes, launch fusion OFF)
reading: of the +2.58pp total, ~+1.47pp is the BYTES (native e4m3 residency) and ~+1.09pp is the LAUNCH FUSION (e65ef35b). Both halves are real and they compose -- which is the specific thing e65ef35b was written to guarantee: before it, native residency silently un-fused the trunk.

question: e4m3 in-kernel dequant vs the Q8_0 re-encode are DIFFERENT arithmetic, so bit-identity is the wrong question BETWEEN CONTAINERS
protocol: teacher-force BOTH arms on the slab arm's own greedy tape (128 ids) -> identical inputs at every position; count argmax disagreements + the tape's NLL under each arm

control_A_slab.note: the reference reproducing its own tape = 0 disagreements. This validates the instrument: a nonzero control would have meant the harness, not the arm, was the source of any difference.

verdict: 2/128 near-tie flips, and e4m3's NLL on the SAME tape is LOWER (0.220117 vs 0.222145, -0.91%) -- the native arm models the reference's own token sequence slightly BETTER, consistent with e4m3 being the checkpoint's own precision and the Q8_0 re-encode being the lossy extra hop. Nothing here is a quality regression.

name: kernel-check
